name: Simulated Multiplayer Clown vs. Demon FPS

mentions.name: Simulated Multiplayer Clown vs. Demon FPS
mentions.description: An old-school first-person shooter where clowns and demons fight it out, playable solo or with invited friends in co-op. The multiplayer feel is simulated with virtual players so the server is always full, including simulated clans, chat, and trash talking. Planned to launch on Steam, hopefully early 2027.
mentions.problem: Older players with worse reflexes no longer enjoy real multiplayer FPS games against always-on 24/7 players who continually one-shot them, so this game simulates a lively multiplayer environment instead.
mentions.audience: Aimed at the author and players like them who loved classic multiplayer shooters (Team Fortress Classic, Counter Strike, Call of Duty) but stopped playing due to age and worse reflexes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an old-school "multiplayer" FPS with clowns and demons fighting it out. It's single player or invite co-op for friends. Multiplayer is simulated with virtual players so the server is always full. There are clans, chat, trash talking, all that, but all simulated (aside from co-op friends of course).
mentions.author: piperflatline
